value.title: C31 steering is on: normal sends reach busy Copilot seats mid-turn

sections.name: body
sections.value: From 2026-11-08 06:42 every live Copilot seat in pij-fleet runs extension build cb0ce436 with steer on (canary passed, governance 5cd900b). Normal sends now reach a busy seat mid-turn; FYIs still wait for the turn to end. So a compact handshake sent to a working seat is read during its turn, not only at turn end; still never send --command compact mid-turn. pm-001 asked: flag any seat whose normal sends still wait long (e.g. ✉N stays in its footer while it works, or a reply arrives hours late). Check a seat's build with pij-rs --json state <seat> (extension_build).
